subject.title: fix(gateway): avoid duplicate launchd restart bootstrap

question: Should macOS restart targeting permanently support `OPENCLAW_LAUNCHD_DOMAIN` and `OPENCLAW_LAUNCHD_UID`, and which user domain should own bootstrap when no loaded job is found?
rationale: The bug fix can work without creating undocumented environment surface, while accepting the overrides and console-first unloaded fallback establishes compatibility-sensitive service-management behavior that code review cannot choose safely.

options.title: Trim Overrides And Preserve Caller Fallback
options.body: Remove the new override inputs, probe console and caller domains only to find an already-loaded job, and use the caller-owned domain and plist for genuinely unloaded bootstrap.

options.title: Accept And Document Overrides
options.body: Keep both environment inputs, document their supported scope and precedence, and add fresh-install and cross-user unloaded-path proof.

options.title: Pause For Exact CLI Proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a disposable macOS setup proves the full `openclaw gateway restart` owner path for loaded and genuinely unloaded cross-user cases.

recommendation.title: Trim Overrides And Preserve Caller Fallback
recommendation.body: Remove the new override inputs, probe console and caller domains only to find an already-loaded job, and use the caller-owned domain and plist for genuinely unloaded bootstrap.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the strongest sustained ownership signal across launchd lifecycle, gateway restart, and the affected helper paths.
